hook: As FTC Chair, Lina Khan opened the agency's inquiry into the multi-billion-dollar partnerships tying cloud providers to leading AI model developers, including Microsoft-OpenAI, Amazon-Anthropic and Google-Anthropic.
name: Lina Khan

quote.text: Our study will shed light on whether investments and partnerships pursued by dominant companies risk distorting innovation and undermining fair competition.
quote.context: Lina Khan, FTC press release announcing the generative AI 6(b) inquiry, January 25, 2024

moniker: Former Chair of the US Federal Trade Commission

primary.name: Lina M. Khan Sworn in as Chair of the FTC, FTC press release, June 15, 2021
FTC Launches Inquiry into Generative AI Investments and Partnerships, FTC press release, January 25, 2024
Leadership Calendar: Former Chair Lina M. Khan, January 2025, FTC.gov

timeline.event: Sworn in as Chair of the Federal Trade Commission
timeline.impact: Becomes the FTC's youngest chair after Senate confirmation as a commissioner

timeline.event: FTC issues Section 6(b) orders to Alphabet, Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and OpenAI on AI investments and partnerships
timeline.impact: Opens a formal study of cloud-provider and AI-lab partnership structures

timeline.event: FTC issues its staff report on the AI partnerships and investments study
timeline.impact: Publishes findings on competitive effects of the Microsoft-OpenAI, Amazon-Anthropic and Google-Anthropic partnerships

timeline.event: Leaves office as FTC Chair at the end of the Biden administration, succeeded by Andrew Ferguson
timeline.impact: Concludes her term as FTC Chair

quick_facts: Served as Chair of the Federal Trade Commission from June 15, 2021 to January 20, 2025, succeeded by Andrew Ferguson
Opened a Section 6(b) inquiry on January 25, 2024 into AI investments and partnerships involving Alphabet, Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and OpenAI
The FTC published its staff report on the AI partnerships and investments study in January 2025
Left office at the end of the Biden administration on January 20, 2025
Became head of the Center for Law and the Economy at Columbia University in 2026

achievements.title: Chair, Federal Trade Commission, 2021 to 2025
achievements.impact: Led the FTC's competition and consumer protection enforcement agenda during a period of expanding AI industry consolidation and cross-company investment.

achievements.title: Generative AI partnerships 6(b) inquiry, opened January 2024
achievements.impact: Directed the FTC to issue compulsory orders to Alphabet, Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and OpenAI examining the Microsoft-OpenAI, Amazon-Anthropic and Google-Anthropic partnerships, resulting in a January 2025 staff report on AI partnership structures.
